phase: source-only mechanism diagnostic, not learned policy or final method
method: Reuse the exact 80 frozen real report observations on46 source groups. Both arms receive identical provenance/risk fields and original current images. Advisory includes unfiltered sections; Contract excludes a report if narrow cross-section flags occur, otherwise excludes sentences containing temporal markers. Empty eligibility gets no wrapper in both. This is a source-derived deterministic mechanism diagnostic, not learning effectiveness.
probe: No forced new report acquisition. Paired existing observations are reused verbatim by source/image. Neither source question/options nor clinical reference is used by the filter. Native4 tools remain identically available; newly invoked report outputs receive the same arm-specific admission transform. All additional calls and controller tokens counted.
shared_interface_revision: Reuse previous paired-run shared interface and guards. If no image is eligible, both arms receive the identical Fixed context (no empty observation wrapper). Other parser and scoring rules unchanged.
feedback: Only 13 source-aligned visual-discriminator cases receive benchmark agreement feedback. Etiology/management details remain unadjudicated. All other reference outcomes are withheld and cannot be semantic learning rewards. All46 can contribute execution/cost/error evidence.
controls: Same initial Fixed prior, model, input order, shared parser/visual safeguards, tool config, budgets and risk-envelope schema. Arm order alternates by immutable source execution index. Token lengths change when content is withheld: not token matched and cannot isolate all shortening effects. No old prediction reused as control, both arms rerun once.
selection_and_evaluation: Complete92 attempted episodes before qualified targets loaded. No new clinical truth/reward. No automatic promotion, no read of24 development/48 frozen/96 confirmation. Diagnostic continuation signal only: source net gain>=1, source loss0, valid final answers do not decrease; otherwise do not integrate this filter as effective. Even passing needs a separately frozen HCL candidate and repeated-development gate.
budget: 1h original hard deadline shared by retries, 2GB apparent stop line, strict actual<50GB. No new models/images copied; existing approved assets read-only. At most92 episodes,736 native tool requests,736 controller calls; no outcome retries.
stop: Stop on privacy or visual-contract invariant breach; preserve failures and budgets. No post-result parser relaxation or outcome-dependent repeat.
measurement: All46 sources execution/cost; only13 known visual-option-reference agreement. Failed recorded arms count incorrect;33 unknown remain null. Raw report acquisition80 calls historical, equal shared antecedent, not newly measured savings. Added native tools may mediate effects; gains require per-trace attribution separating formatting. Contract cannot claim corrected medical facts.
motivation: Post-hoc audit found27/80 reports with temporal phrases despite single-image inputs and5/80 narrow cross-section opposition flags. Test hard provenance admission against the same warnings without hard exclusion before adding an HCL learned state-dependent acquisition mechanism.
reference_scope: Same frozen46 source groups/13 qualified visual-feedback groups/33unknown and exact approved images as previous acquisition; repeated source data, not additional independent samples.

filter_frozen.cross_section_rules: audit.OPPOSED plus conservative sentence negation guard
filter_frozen.cross_section_action: quarantine whole report, retain original only in private log
filter_frozen.temporal_action: quarantine whole sentence; absence of admitted text means unknown, not normal
filter_frozen.scope: advisory and contract both show identical flags; only report content admitted differs
